text: Can you put together every open or recent ticket and feature request on Marrow Agrisupply and Marrow Fieldworks? Pull from our team channels and Moss's Central notes, and label each one by account. I need the list for the Marrow review on Thursday.
reply_text:
I posted the list in #central-team as a reply to your message.

It has four Marrow Agrisupply items: PD-4821 (Eastbank door labels), the Pine Crossing morning-shift problem, the store-by-store blocker list that is still pending, and FR-882 (pallet-jack icons). I found nothing for Marrow Fieldworks in the Central channel or Moss's Central notes, so that section is empty.

Two tickets from Moss's January digest, #4409 and #4412, don't name an account. I listed them separately and didn't guess a label. The digest mentions "Pree's dealer account," so someone on the team can confirm which account they belong to.

I only read the Central sources you named. Statuses are as of the latest messages, so please check the tracker before Thursday.
